From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Discovery recap + model mix (chat/embeddings/rerank) — next steps

Hi Sara / Mike —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying asks so we can put together a tailored pricing + pilot plan: 

Key takeaways we heard from BrightLayer:
- Primary feature set: chat-based product assistant (user messages -> multi-turn responses) + periodic embedding-based semantic search for knowledge articles + a light reranking step for top-N results.
- Expected monthly volume (approx): chat requests, embeddings, rerank (we discussed approximate ranges; please confirm):
  • Chat (generation): ~150–250M tokens/month
  • Embeddings (batch + on-request): ~50–100M tokens/month
  • Rerank (short sequences): ~5–15M tokens/month
- Average chat sequence length we discussed: ~400–600 tokens (avg ~512).

Questions / asks for you:
1) Can you confirm the expected per-month token volumes by model class (chat / embeddings / rerank) and whether the ranges above look right?
2) What target pricing band do you have in mind (you mentioned $/1M tokens previously) — ballpark range helps us recommend hosted vs. dedicated.
3) Any regulatory/network constraints (VPC, data residency) we should factor into the proposal?

Unit-economics notes (preliminary):
- For hosted (Redwood API) we typically quote per-1M-token pricing. For this mix and scale, ballpark unit costs we expect to recommend:
  • Chat (Larger chat models): $14–$22 per 1M tokens (hosted list; can be lower with committed reserved capacity)
  • Embeddings: $6–$12 per 1M tokens (depends on model/dim and batch rates)
  • Rerank / light models: $4–$10 per 1M tokens
- With a 1-year committed reserved capacity and predictable traffic, we can typically provide a 20–40% discount vs hosted list pricing (depends on model mix, seq length, and commit level).

Next steps I propose:
- Please confirm volumes by model class and your target $/1M tokens (range is fine).
- Once we have that, I will send a pricing proposal + SOW and propose a pilot plan (4–8 week technical pilot on Redwood Dedicated or hosted with a spike plan).

Attaching a simple pricing workbook (BrightLayer-pricing-v1.xlsx) to capture volumes/lines for modeling.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Discovery recap + model mix (chat/embeddings/rerank) — next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary — that's exactly right directionally. Confirming our current internal estimates (these are our current planning numbers, could shift as we ramp):
- Chat (generation): 150M tokens/month (month 1–3), trending up to ~220M by month 6
- Embeddings: ~75M tokens/month (mix of batch ingests + API calls)
- Rerank: ~10M tokens/month (top-K rerank on search results)

Target pricing: we're budgeting for ~$15–$20 per 1M tokens on average across the stack (we understand chat will be the most expensive piece).

We are very interested in understanding the committed-discount math — what a 1-year $/token looks like vs hosted list. Also: we need to keep data within US regions and require SOC2 evidence (happy to share a checklist).

If you can send a short proposal with committed pricing scenarios (monthly commits and expected net $/1M tokens), we can review internally and share with procurement.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Collins
Head of Platform Engineering, BrightLayer
sara.collins@brightlayer.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Collins <sara.collins@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-06T13:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + model mix (chat/embeddings/rerank) — next steps

Appreciate the quick reply, Sara — this is very helpful. A few clarifications and what we'll include in the proposal: 

1) Pricing bands (illustrative net examples we can target based on the volumes you mentioned):
   - Hosted list (no commit): Chat $18–$22 / 1M tokens; Embeddings $8–$12 / 1M tokens; Rerank $5–$9 / 1M tokens
   - 1-year reserved commit (example): with a $X/month commit we can target ~20–30% lower vs hosted list — that would put blended net around $12–$16 / 1M tokens for your projected mix. Exact depends on model selection (e.g., Llama-3-1.3B vs 7B vs private larger models) and seq lengths.

2) Sequence length & batching impact: your avg chat seq ~512 tokens helps us model cost accurately — a longer average will push up per-token inference cost due to attention & kv cache; embeddings cost depends heavily on batch size for high throughput. We'll model both batch and on-demand embedding calls.

3) Procurement/Security: we can provide SOC2, and for production we'll recommend provisioning in our US region with VPC options for Dedicated. I'll include links to our compliance pack in the proposal.

Next steps: I'll work with Rishi and Dev to assemble a 2-option proposal (hosted pilot vs 1-year reserved commit) + SOW and send by EOD Wednesday. If that timeline works, we'll also include a sample DocuSign SOW link to fast-track signature.

Best,
Marissa

On a related note, Rishi / Dev — please see Sara's confirmed volumes above and the target $15–$20 band. Can you run a model-select + price estimate for the following splits (use avg chat seq 512 tokens):
   • Option A (hosted pilot): Chat 150M, Embeddings 75M, Rerank 10M
   • Option B (1yr commit): Chat 200M, Embeddings 75M, Rerank 10M (aim for blended net $12–$16 / 1M)

I'll consolidate and send the proposal later today.
